Fit a simple non-stationary GEV model

Source: R/advanced-extremes.R
fit_nonstationary_gev.Rd

Estimates a GEV distribution allowing the location parameter to vary linearly with time if `trend` is TRUE. This implementation uses maximum likelihood from the ismev package when available and falls back to optimisation via stats::optim otherwise.

Usage

fit_nonstationary_gev(x, trend = TRUE)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector of block maxima.

trend

Logical. If TRUE include a linear trend in the location parameter.

Value

List containing estimated parameters.

Examples

x <- block_maxima(rnorm(1000), 50)
fit_nonstationary_gev(x)
#> $location
#> [1] 2.065755
#> 
#> $location_trend
#> [1] 0.2221423
#> 
#> $scale
#> [1] 0.3852404
#> 
#> $shape
#> [1] -0.04518581
#> 
#> $convergence
#> [1] 0
#>
